workspaceSettings.generalDesc: Core details of this workspace and what lives in it.

workspaceSettings.colorDesc: The workspace's mark — in the switcher and wherever it stands next to others.
workspaceSettings.urlDesc: Part of every shared link and every invitation. It does not change with the name.
workspaceSettings.projectsDesc: Projects in this workspace you are allowed to see; manage them under “Projects”.
workspaceSettings.membersDesc: People with access to this workspace.

workspaceMembers.roleFailed: The role could not be changed.
